heroHeadline: Takaichi Enters Reshuffle Season as Yen Rallies, BOJ Rate Hike Nears, and Defense Ministry Bets on AI Warfare
heroSubtitle: PM Takaichi plans a continuity-focused Cabinet reshuffle for mid-September as the yen strengthens to a 7-month high on near-certain BOJ rate-hike bets following an upward Q2 GDP revision, and the Defense Ministry unveils a record ¥8.9T FY2027 budget centered on an 'AI orchestrator' command platform, hypersonic missiles, and attack drones
